svg.title: The Ping-Post Exclusionary Auction
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-ping-post-auction-gates; chapter number: 5; chart type: decision_tree; title: The Ping-Post Exclusionary Auction; subtitle: Four gates between a non-contact ping and a paid PII post; caption: A non-contact ping fires simultaneously to every eligible buyer; the best bid minus margin returns to the seller, and the PII post lands only after the buyer returns success.; assumptions note: Timeouts of 15 s ping and 30 s post are boberdoo's typical windows; another boberdoo setup returns a generic unmatched after 20 seconds. The $10 bid minus $2 margin and the 15% refund cap over 30 days are boberdoo examples, not fixed rules.; note: Sources: boberdoo.com (yCAVYNpSdZI, YLw0lKsOayk, lpWTQpnduYo, EKrBDZYFq2A), Scott Hoffman and Brett of boberdoo, Lead Prosper.; nodes: gate: G1; question: Does the buyer hold an active account, funds and a matching filter set?; pass next: G2; fail action: Excluded from the ping; extra fields that trip the filter set are common.; gate: G2; question: Did the buyer bid inside the ping window (15 s typical)?; pass next: G3; fail action: Lagging buyer excluded so the seller still gets a bid or a generic unmatched.; gate: G3; question: Does the best bid minus margin still clear ($10 bid - $2 margin = $8 offer)?; pass next: G4; fail action: Stay on 'Yes'; the 'yes but sold non-exclusively' fallback can sell at a loss.; gate: G4; question: Did the vendor accept the $8 offer and the buyer return success on the post (30 s)?; pass next: Post PII, bill the buyer, enforce a 15% refund cap over 30 days; fail action: No PII is posted; read Show Lead Log bottom-up for 'price is missing' errors.

circle.title: gate: G1; question: Does the buyer hold an active account, funds and a matching filter set?; pass next: G2; fail action: Excluded from the ping; extra fields that trip the filter set are common.
gate: G2; question: Did the buyer bid inside the ping window (15 s typical)?; pass next: G3; fail action: Lagging buyer excluded so the seller still gets a bid or a generic unmatched.

gate: G3; question: Does the best bid minus margin still clear ($10 bid - $2 margin = $8 offer)?; pass next: G4; fail action: Stay on 'Yes'; the 'yes but sold non-exclusively' fallback can sell at a loss.

gate: G4; question: Did the vendor accept the $8 offer and the buyer return success on the post (30 s)?; pass next: Post PII, bill the buyer, enforce a 15% refund cap over 30 days; fail action: No PII is posted; read Show Lead Log bottom-up for 'price is missing' errors.

text.title: Assumptions: Timeouts of 15 s ping and 30 s post are boberdoo's typical windows; another boberdoo setup returns a generic unmatched after 20 seconds. The $10 bid minus $2 margin and the 15% refund cap over 30 days are boberdoo examples, not fixed rules.
text.tspan: Assumptions: Timeouts of 15 s ping and 30 s post are boberdoo's typical windows; another boberdoo setup returns a generic unmatched
after 20 seconds. The $10 bid minus $2 margin and the 15% refund cap over 30 days are boberdoo examples, not fixed rules.
